title: Joyous Youth
overview: The members of the Hero Club look forward to resuming their normal lives. And that means fun activities like band practice, karaoke, airsoft matches and camping trips!

title: I Offer You My Everything
overview: Back in Divine Era Year 298, Taisha gathers a group of candidates. One of them will become the next hero, and Mebuki will ensure that it will be her.

title: Smallest Joys
overview: The Sentinels have a dangerous task. Although Mebuki’s leadership has prevented fatalities, not everyone stays. Those who leave are replaced as if they were nothing but tools.

title: Oracle
overview: The Sentinels do not have the powers of a hero, but they have each other. When the Vertex unexpectedly attack, Mebuki and her team face a battle unlike anything before.

title: Brightness Unleashed
overview: Sonoko’s family possessed The Hero Records for generations. When she entrusts it to the Hero Club, they learn about the first heroes who defended humanity against the Vertex.

title: Ease My Fears
overview: People are cruel, a fact Chikage is all too well aware of.

title: You Will Never Be Forgotten
overview: Two friends with different perspectives arrive at a crossroads, and conflict is inevitable. And when conflict occurs, consequences follow.

title: Eternal Vow
overview: What does it mean to be a hero? Wakaba and Yuna are about to find out.

title: True Friendship
overview: Karin rages against the gods who cursed Yuuna, but they don’t answer when she issues a challenge from beyond the barrier. Instead, she finds the Sentinels and an old rival.

title: Power Born of Adversity
overview: The Heroes begin their final mission, but they weren’t the only ones fighting that day. While they battled the enemy, the Sentinels were holding the line.

title: My Heart Burns
overview: Tougou will do anything to save Yuuna, even if it means defying the will of the gods.

title: Everlasting Joy
overview: The battle is over at long last. Now, the Hero Club must ask what comes next.
